notes.title: Summer Update
notes.notes: While working on the Story mode, I wanted to update the game with the more polished mechanics I've developed, as well as more puzzles. Enjoy![img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25674575/b64efa514ea7764b69a7bfb9aa74a4947d2ac23b.png[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25674575/b019a3d2a4d3546e08fa209efe7bccc0d4410b22.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Zen Mode Update
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25674575/5d82a9e9380721bbe6289c230f73df45b9a1777b.png[/img]

- Added Zen Mode!
- Enjoy minigames and endless puzzles!
- Lots of work behind the scenes on A.I for story mode!
- New NPC in Home screen to explain about the menu for new players

Story Mode is coming along nicely. I'm working on something special for you guys and I don't wanna spoil it. If you are here for the summer sale: I hope Early Access doesn't scare you and you choose to support this VR game!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25674575/63867b9b6a9f07ace5b631baaa6e7204c2921cbe.png[/img]

notes.title: UPDATE 1.2 - The New Student
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25674575/14c118a483b63b13f9ebe710da211d4ad935cb67.png[/img]
This is a pretty big update, too many changes to list, but in a nutshell:

- Added NPCs
- New hand models
- New interaction models
- First story level added! "The New Student"
- Puzzle Blocks Maker design overhaul and countless fixes
- New in-game menu
- New workshop in-game access

& Much more coming soon! All thanks to you, everyone who supported this game!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25674575/22645a9dfd1b78e3cb5da9783fd26c6b19ae7ec6.png[/img]

notes.title: UPDATE 1.0.2 - Edit Puzzle Hints Feature
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25674575/79ee0333db9393970d932d31a573bad53efaa0c3.gif[/img]

You can now edit the hints on your puzzles and make them more challenging!

[u]New features:[/u]

- Added 'Edit Hints' button to the puzzle editing screen. You can now make your puzzles more challenging, and even create traditional 2D Nonogram puzzles!

[b]Webm of the new feature in action:[/b]

https://gfycat.com/IgnorantGoodKilldeer

notes.title: HOTFIX 1.0.1 - 2 Fixes, 1 new Feature (By request)
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25674575/d985140076637450c9799fe7464ba7c4a0e5154d.gif[/img]

While I'm working hard on the next update, I decided to push out this very important hotfix:

[u]Fixes:[/u]
- Fixed bug where the floor would disappear in some Workshop Levels. [b](I have also flagged levels who had this bug as incompatible in the workshop)[/b]

- Fixed bug where one of the controllers would constantly vibrate after picking up or releasing the hammer.

[u]New Features:[/u]

- You can now pull puzzles towards you if you press & hold the touchpad on any controller that's not currently holding an object (As requested on the forums by a non-roomscale player)

[b]Webm of this new 'Puzzle Pull' feature for non-roomscale players:[/b]

https://gfycat.com/FastFelineBarnswallow
